name: Damageable
description: Anything that has health and can be hurt or healed. Implement it on a character, a crate or a door, and any Blueprint can damage it without knowing which.

methods.name: take_damage
methods.doc: Reduce health by amount. Called by whatever dealt the damage.

methods.name: heal
methods.doc: Restore health by amount, up to the maximum.

methods.name: is_alive
methods.doc: True while health is above zero.
